evidence: The diffraction studies revealed that the films grown at the higher temperatures on a-Al2O3(012) substrates contained highly oriented rutile since only the 101 reflection was detected in the diffractograms (Fig.2A). For films grown below 375 1C only diffuse 101 rutile peaks with very low intensities were observed, while for the film deposited at 2551C no peaks were observed indicating amorphous films. The XRD patterns of the films grown on MgO(001) substrates are shown in Fig.2B and they reveal formation of [200] oriented anatase already at 2301C.
